## Quick Answer

Cold Foil on PET Labels for High-Gloss Metallic Effects should be specified by process route, substrate, adhesive or UV varnish compatibility, artwork detail, and finished-package durability. For label and sleeve printers, the safest buying path is to test the foil on PET film and treated label stock, using the actual machine route for beverage labels, cosmetic labels, and shrink sleeves. The main purchasing risk is dimensional stability, gloss, and fine line transfer. Do not approve a cold foil roll by color alone; approve it by transfer completeness, edge clarity, gloss, adhesion, rub resistance, and repeatability at production speed.

## Where This Cold Foil Topic Fits

- Target buyer: label and sleeve printers.

- Typical substrate: PET film and treated label stock.

- Application: beverage labels, cosmetic labels, and shrink sleeves.

- Primary keyword: cold foil on PET labels.

- Main risk to control: dimensional stability, gloss, and fine line transfer.

## Technical Selection Points

Cold foil is different from conventional hot stamping because the metallic layer is normally transferred through adhesive or UV/LED-curable varnish rather than a heated metal die. In practice, the foil grade, varnish chemistry, curing energy, pressure contact, web or sheet control, and surface treatment work as one system. If one part changes, the approved result may change even when the foil color looks identical.

- Confirm whether the job uses digital cold foil, screen printing cold foil, narrow-web cold foil, sheet-fed offset cold foil, or another UV cold transfer route.

- Ask for sample rolls or swatches and test on the production substrate, not only on a standard coated card.

- Record machine speed, UV or LED energy, pressure or nip setting, roll width, core size, foil tension, adhesive batch, and substrate batch.

- For overprinted metallic colors, approve the final CMYK-over-foil appearance under the same lighting used by the brand owner.

## Sampling and Quality Tests

A useful cold foil trial should include the hardest artwork area: fine text, small logos, large solid metallic panels, barcodes, folds, curves, or die-cut edges. For cosmetic and label packaging, add dry rub, tape pull, alcohol wipe, scratch or scuff checks, and retained master samples. For cartons, also test folding, stacking, lamination sequence, and post-press handling. The recommended machine settings must be treated as a starting window and confirmed by sampling.

## Common Failure Signs

- Poor adhesion or foil peeling usually points to substrate surface energy, UV varnish compatibility, insufficient cure timing, contamination, or wrong topcoat.

- Incomplete transfer, pinholes, or speckling often comes from uneven varnish laydown, dust, low pressure contact, rough stock, or foil release mismatch.

- Blurry edges, filled-in fine text, or metallic spread usually means the adhesive image is spreading, the screen/plate resolution is too low, or pressure is too high.

- Dull gloss and weak metallic density can come from poor foil contact, incompatible varnish, over-cure, under-cure, or non-smooth substrate surfaces.

## Procurement Checklist

- Send the supplier real substrate, final artwork, production process, expected speed, durability tests, roll width, core size, color target, and order quantity.

- Request one recommended grade plus one backup grade when the job includes difficult substrates, alcohol exposure, curved parts, or large metallic areas.

- Approve the result only after visual, adhesion, abrasion, alcohol, and downstream finishing checks match the customer requirement.

## 中文版本：核心结论

PET 标签冷烫高亮金属效果怎么做 不能只按颜色下单，应同时确认工艺路线、底材、UV 光油或胶水兼容性、图稿细节和成品耐性。对 label and sleeve printers 来说，最稳妥的采购方式是在 PET film and treated label stock 上，用真实机台和真实图稿完成 beverage labels, cosmetic labels, and shrink sleeves 的打样。核心风险是 dimensional stability, gloss, and fine line transfer。冷烫膜应按转移完整度、边缘清晰度、金属光泽、附着力、耐磨和量产重复性来验收。

## 中文版本：选型要点

- 先确认属于数码冷烫、丝印冷烫、窄幅标签冷烫、单张纸胶印冷烫，还是其他 UV 冷转移工艺。

- 用量产底材打样，记录光油或胶水、UV/LED 能量、压力、速度、张力、卷宽、卷芯和底材批次。

- 如果冷烫后还要套印 CMYK，必须确认最终金属色，而不是只确认银底或金底。

- 化妆品、香水、标签和塑料包装建议增加干擦、胶带、酒精擦拭、刮擦或运输磨损测试。

## 中文版本：常见问题

- 掉金或附着力差：重点查底材表面能、UV 光油兼容性、固化状态、污染和保护层。

- 缺金、针孔或麻点：重点查光油铺展、灰尘、压力、底材平整度和离型匹配。

- 糊边或细线断线：重点查图文胶层扩散、网版/印版解析度、压力和固化窗口。

- 光泽发暗：重点查压合接触、光油体系、固化能量和底材表面平滑度。

## Sources and Further Reading

- INX International: hot foil uses heat-activated adhesive; cold foil uses UV or LED cured adhesive. [Read source](https://www.inxinternational.com/blog/shelf-appeal/mastering-art-foil-printing-complete-guide-hot-and-cold-techniques)

- KURZ Cold Transfer: narrow-web cold transfer is widely used for self-adhesive plastic labels and paper labels. [Read source](https://www.kurz-graphics.com/en/cold-transfer/)

- Heidelberg FoilStar: cold transfer is used for wet glue labels, in-mold labels, and packaging metallic effects. [Read source](https://www.heidelberg.com/global/en/print_and_packaging/industries_and_applications/label_production/label_news/expert_talk_foilstar/expert_talk_foilstar_jochen_pecht.jsp)
